# .github/workflows/node.yaml. Installed with --require-hashes so the wheel is

#   curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/ziglang/<version>/json \
#     | jq -r '.urls[] | select(.filename | test("manylinux.*(x86_64|aarch64)")) | .digests.sha256'
